description:
Create a project only when the user asks for a new one, e.g. for another client
or market. A project is a separate workspace with its own websites and exports.
A matching connects only the websites of one project. Each project pays for its
websites: a website in a second project takes another analysis and another paid
scrape. Thus do not create a project for each website. The customer_id is in scout_list_projects.

country: ISO 3166 code of the market of the project, e.g. "CZ".
currency: ISO 4217 code of the prices in the exports, e.g. "CZK".
name: scout_create_project
title: Create a project
